# Factory Direct Homes Center

> Champion manufactured and modular homes with factory-direct pricing in Auburn, Indiana. Authorized dealer serving Indiana, Ohio, Michigan, Wisconsin, Illinois, and Kentucky.

## About

Factory Direct Homes Center is a family-owned, authorized Champion Homes dealer located at 1211 State Road 8, Auburn, IN 46706. We offer new manufactured and modular homes with line-item pricing transparency — no hidden markups. Our showroom is 30 miles from Champion's largest factory in Topeka, Indiana, giving us direct access to their full lineup.

## Contact

- Phone: (260) 308-1457
- Email: sales@factorydirecthomescenter.com
- Address: 1211 State Road 8, Auburn, IN 46706
- Hours: Mon-Fri 9AM-5PM, Sat 10AM-4PM, Sun Closed

## Home Types & Pricing

- Single Wide Homes: from $50,000 (500-1,200 sq ft, 1-3 bed, 1-2 bath)
- Double Wide Homes: from $80,000 (1,000-2,400 sq ft, 2-4 bed, 2-3 bath)
- Modular Homes: from $100,000 (1,200-3,000 sq ft, 3-5 bed, 2-3 bath, IRC code built)

All homes are new Champion-built, customizable, and include manufacturer warranty.

## Service Area

Primary: Indiana (Auburn, Fort Wayne, Indianapolis, Noble County, DeKalb County)
Extended: Ohio (Toledo), Michigan (Kalamazoo), Wisconsin, Illinois, Kentucky

Delivery typically within 150 miles of Auburn, IN. Custom delivery quotes available for all locations.
